def transform(grid):
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))
    pts = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v != bg]

    r0,r1 = min(r for r,c in pts), max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0,c1 = min(c for r,c in pts), max(c for r,c in pts)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for c in range(c0,c1+1):
        if out[r0][c] == bg: out[r0][c] = color
        if out[r1][c] == bg: out[r1][c] = color
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        if out[r][c0] == bg: out[r][c0] = color
        if out[r][c1] == bg: out[r][c1] = color
    # Complete an interior guide line when at least two markers share a row or column.

    interior = [(r,c) for r,c in pts if r not in (r0,r1) and c not in (c0,c1)]

    for c,n in cols.items():

            for r in range(r0,r1+1):
                if out[r][c] == bg: out[r][c]=color
